sources.snippet: Meet LFM2.5-230M, Liquid AI's smallest model yet: a fast, open-weight foundation model for fine-tuning, edge deployment, tool use, and data extraction.

sources.snippet: Ultra-compact 230M parameter model for data extraction and lightweight on-device agentic tasks ← Back to Text Models LFM2.5-230M is Liquid AI's smallest LFM2.5 text model, designed for edge devices with the tightest memory and compute budgets.

sources.title: LFM2.5-230M: Liquid AI Edge Agent Model — 213 tok/s on Phone CPU ...
sources.snippet: ← Back to blog explainx / blog LFM2.5-230M: Liquid AI's 230M Model Built to Run Agents on Phones and Robots Liquid AI released LFM2.5-230M on June 25, 2026 — a 230M-parameter open-weight model with 213 tok/s on Galaxy S25 Ultra and 42 tok/s on Raspberry Pi 5. Built for tool use, data extraction, and on-device agentic workloads.
